summary: BTC holdings increased to 847,363 as of June 28, 2026 (no new purchases this week, reflecting updated cumulative total). Strategy also announced a Digital Credit Capital Framework including repurchase programs for preferred and common stock, a BTC monetization program, revised STRC dividend policy (rate raised to 12.00%), and a USD Reserve policy; 12.67M common shares were sold via ATM for ~$1.15B in net proceeds.

Strategy sold 3,588 BTC during June 29–July 5, 2026 to fund preferred stock distributions, reducing holdings to 843,775 BTC as of July 5, 2026; no equity was issued under the ATM program and no other capital structure changes were reported.
